content: अवसो €4 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To finish, accomplish. .²2 To destroy. .²3 To determine, understand; किमप्यनवसीयमानम् <ls>K. 278</ls>; अवासासीच्च वैयासिकीम् (वाणीम्) <ls>Malli.</ls> .²4 (<ab>Intrans.</ab>) To fail; be at an end; शक्तिर्ममावस्यति हीनयुद्धे <ls>Ki. 16. 17</ls>. .²5 To put up (as at an inn). .²6 To let loose, liberate. .²7 To draw near, approach. .²8 To dwell, stay. .²9 To settle, fix. .²10 To stand firm, to persist in. .²11 To know; अवसेयाश्च कार्याणि धर्मेण पुरवासिनाम् <ls>Bk. 19</ls>. .²12 To get, attain to, reach. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to be completed, finish, complete; अथ विधिमवसाय्य शास्त्रदृष्टम् <ls>R. 5. 76</ls>. .²2 To understand, comprehend; अवसाययितुं क्षमाः सुखम् <ls>Ki. 2. 29</ls>.
